sentences.text: Since a prayer for suspension of sentence has been made in the memo of appeal, let written objection on behalf of the State be also filed by the next date.

5. Let notice be also issued to the mother of the victim (P.W. 2), who is the informant of this case.

7.

8. Re-notify this appeal on receipt of the Trial Court Records on 08th of July, 2024.
